description: Put your own exact words on one classic template. Instant, no AI involved. Use search_templates first to get the template id and its caption slots. captions can be an object (slot -> text) or a list of strings in slot order. Example: template "drake", captions ["Writing tests", "Shipping on Friday"].

captions.description: slot -> text, or a list of texts in slot order

preview.description: Include the meme as an inline image

template.description: Template id, e.g. drake, db (Distracted Boyfriend), fine (This Is Fine)
